overview: Markets reacted to political shifts as AI stocks climbed following a Democrat election victory, while defense secretary Pete Hegseth faced mounting bipartisan scrutiny and a potential impeachment effort. In commercial real estate, Bushburg Properties entered a contract to buy 60 Wall Street at a steep discount, and Starwood Property Trust reported a heavy third-quarter loss. Locally, San Francisco Mayor Lurie consolidated power, and the city secured a significant funding gift to improve Mission BART plazas. Meanwhile, Hawaii made leadership news with the decision not to reappoint the state attorney general who led a major pandemic-era corruption probe.

wiki.title: Bill Madden (soldier)
wiki.extract: Horace William Madden was an Australian Army soldier who was posthumously awarded the George Cross, the highest award for extraordinary acts of gallantry away from the field of battle that could be awarded to a member of the Australian armed forces at the time. The citation for his award highlighted his "undaunted" resistance and "outstanding heroism" while a prisoner of war of the Chinese forces during the Korean War, which was "an inspiration to all his fellow prisoners". It was the highest decoration awarded to an Australian during the Korean War.
